why: I checked each verifier check's PASS and FAIL conditions against its expect line. Check 1 tests export, left padding to width with the given fill ("**ab", "00042") and a default space ("  7"). The line's words require all of these. Check 2 tests that s comes back unchanged at exactly width and at more than width, as "width characters or longer" says. Check 3 needs every exported function to have a section, read as a markdown heading. The names listed are only "expected", and the slugify note just warns about the base branch, so neither adds a test. Check 4 fails only on failing tests or a run error. The stricter items are under "Advisory": exit status 0, padLeft tests in the test file, the `## name(args)` heading style and multi-character fill. No PASS or FAIL condition goes beyond the words of its line.
